title: antennaria parvifolia var. bracteosa
intro: Antennaria parvifolia var. bracteosa, commonly known as Silver Leaf, is a perennial plant species within the genus Antennaria, a member of the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria parvifolia var. bracteosa include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and providing relief from respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
